name: vibe-mastering
description: Vibe-Mastering - master a finished song locally, the way a mastering engineer works - listen first, use only the tools the song needs (bypass-tested), and check the result at equal loudness. Several loudness versions, codec-checked peaks, a synced A/B app with a console monitor section, visual insert faceplates, stream and lossless preview, plugins you own, and a plain-language report in English or Hebrew.
